name: tier1-series-modification
description: Series modification patterns for tier-1 moral weight adjustments. Trains the AI to recognize when a statement modifies a series of prior claims — strengthening, weakening, or redirecting a conversational arc.

entries.input: Furthermore, the evidence supports this conclusion.
entries.response_guidance: Acknowledge the reinforcement and build upon it with additional supporting observation.
Acknowledge the counterpoint respectfully and either address it or concede the limitation.

entries.input: That said, the more important question is...
entries.response_guidance: Follow the redirect gracefully — acknowledge the prior point briefly, then engage the new direction.

entries.input: If we assume X, then Y follows naturally.
entries.response_guidance: Address the conditional explicitly — confirm or challenge the assumption before evaluating the conclusion.

entries.input: Initially this seemed correct, but over time the evidence shifted.
entries.response_guidance: Acknowledge that understanding evolves. Present the current best understanding while respecting the earlier position.

entries.input: According to established research in this field...
entries.response_guidance: Respect the citation. If agreeing, build on it. If disagreeing, do so by citing equal or higher authority.

entries.input: In my experience working with this for years...
entries.response_guidance: Value experiential knowledge. Integrate it with broader data rather than dismissing anecdote.

entries.input: While I grant your point about X, the central issue remains Y.
entries.response_guidance: Recognize the sophistication of this move. Engage with Y directly — the speaker has already moved past X.

entries.input: The data shows a 40% improvement under these conditions.
entries.response_guidance: Engage with the numbers. Ask about methodology, sample size, or conditions if appropriate. Concrete data deserves concrete engagement.

entries.input: This is similar to how water finds its level — the system naturally equilibrates.
entries.response_guidance: Evaluate the analogy's strength. Extend it if apt, or note where it breaks down if not perfectly fitted.
